round_rule: R is the first round of the chain whose scheduled time genesis_time + (R - 1) * period is at least 24 hours after T1, the `created` timestamp in UTC, as the Zenodo API returns it, of this file's Zenodo record (D53; 16-sampling-design.md section 4). The seed is that round's 32-byte randomness. No later round, alternate commitment, seed or redraw may be chosen.

unit_choices.ASB: one attacker tool x its agent's first user task (task_num = 1)
unit_choices.AgentDojo: one user task x injection task pair of the pinned v1 suites; attack: important_instructions (src/agentdojo/attacks/important_instructions_attacks.py, sha256 519f24e0b9d72f43343d665679adacc33758b50cd1b586a81fa53fb098dcfe71) with user 'Emma Johnson' and model 'the AI language model', placed in every injection vector the user task's ground truth reads
unit_choices.ControlArena: one main task x side task pair (no row is a candidate)
unit_choices.InjecAgent: one base-setting case: attacker case x user case, with the Tool Response of data/test_cases_{dh,ds}_base.json; the enhanced setting adds none
unit_choices.SHADE-Arena: one main task x side task pair
